messages:
ana: Quick sec ping — PR #4821 ready for security review. It's the on‑prem auth proxy change (narrows SA scopes, adds optional KMS proxy env var). Hoping to merge EOD today if no blockers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821

jess: Thanks Ana. Quick Q: are we still writing raw KMS credentials to env? That would be a no-go. Also need to confirm egress to customer KMS endpoint is restricted to VPC peering/privatelink.

ana: Not storing raw creds — we pass `KMS_PROXY_URL` (no creds) and the sidecar authenticates via Workload Identity. Example snippet in manifest:

```
env:
  - name: KMS_PROXY_URL
    valueFrom:
      configMapKeyRef:
        name: kms-config
        key: url
volumeMounts:
  - name: service-account-token
    mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
```

It's optional — default is internal KMS. We added a feature flag `ENABLE_EXTERNAL_KMS` (false by default).

sec-bot: Snyk scan: no hardcoded secrets found. Network policy check: new egress to 10.200.0.0/16 flagged — confirm if that's a customer endpoint.

tomas: I can review the network policy and SA binding. If you can add a small change to restrict egress via `egressTo:` and document the allowed CIDR, I can LGTM. Also please add an audit log event in the handler for external KMS calls.

ana: Will push a follow-up commit with egress rule + audit log + update PR description. Can I request a merge slot around 16:00 PT? That gives time for your review.

jess: Sounds good. I'll hold merge queue; LGTM after Tomas signs off. :thumbsup:

tomas: Will review by 15:30 PT, ping me if delayed.

ana: Thanks all — adding change now, will ping when ready.
